headline: Heard trespass appeal hearings for Jayden Sweeney and Eric Gravel before moving into Deliberative Session.
summary: The committee held public forum comments on City Hall trespass policy and conduct concerns, then heard testimony in two trespass appeal hearings: In re: Matter of Jayden Sweeney and In re: Matter of Eric Gravel. After questions, the committee moved into Deliberative Session, and no decisions on the appeals are recorded in these minutes.

Page 1 of 2 
 
 
Public Safety Committee 
Tuesday, September 8, 2026 
Remote via Zoom/In-Person in Sharon Bushor Conference Room, 1st Floor, City Hall, 
Burlington, Vermont   
DRAFT MINUTES 
  
Members Present:  Buddy Singh (Chair), Melo Grant, Laura Sanchez-Parkinson 
  
Staff Present: Hayley McClenahan (Assistant City Attorney), Jessica Brown (City Attorney), 
Shawn Burke (BPD Chief) 
 
Public Present: Todd DeLuca, Tanya Benosky, Jayden Sweeney, Eric Gravel 
 
Meeting called to order at 5:32 PM by Councilor Singh. 
  
1.   Adopt the Agenda 
     1.01 Adopt the Agenda 
  
Motion to adopt the agenda as written.  
 
Motion by Councilor Grant, Seconded by Councilor Sanchez-Parkinson 
Final Resolution: Motion Passes 
Yes: Unanimous 
 
2.   Public Forum 
     2.01  Verbal Comments 
 
Todd DeLuca commented on the City Hall trespass policy and that it does not protect the 
constitutional rights of the public and asked that councilors exercise their executive power to 
uphold first amendment rights.  DeLuca added the conduct of the security guard when issuing the 
trespass was concerning.     
 
Tanya Benosky, Executive Director of the Boys & Girls Club of Burlington, commented on their 
experience with appellant Jayden Sweeney’s behavior and urged the Committee to consider the 
safety and wellbeing of the children using Roosevelt Park.   
 
Public Forum closed at 5:43 PM. 
 
3.  Trespass Appeal Hearings 
     3.01  In re: Matter of Jayden Sweeney 
 
The Committee heard testimony from Chief Burke and appellant Jayden Sweeney.  The 
Committee had the opportunity to ask questions before moving to Deliberative Session. 
 
   3.02  In re: Matter of Eric Gravel
Page 2 of 2 
 
 
The Committee heard testimony from City Attorney Brown and appellant Eric Gravel.  The 
Committee had the opportunity to ask questions before moving to Deliberative Session. 
 
5.  Adjournment 
     5.01 Motion to Adjourn 
 
Motion to adjourn the appeal hearing and move into Deliberative Session. 
 
The meeting was adjourned with no objection at 6:39 PM.
